_comment: Build config for the end-to-end QR scan harness (tool/e2e/). Safe to commit: demo mode never initialises Firebase (see main.dart), so no key belongs here. Use mobile/env.json for anything that must reach the live backend.
_comment_demo: The harness runs on seeded on-device data on purpose. It writes no visit, mints no voucher and touches no real customer, so it can be run as often as you like — and the Firestore emulator needs a JRE this machine does not have.
_comment_domain: Must match the host baked into the QR fixtures, because parseCheckInTarget only accepts a check-in link on a known host. Without this, demo mode falls back to eatstreak.app and every production-shaped code resolves as an external QR — the harness would pass while testing the wrong branch.
